authority.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
authority.publisher: GBIF Secretariat and the occurrence-record publishers identified in the retained response

terms.license: Retained occurrence records declare either CC BY 4.0 or CC0 1.0 record-level licenses.

geography.method: Registered exact provider county-equivalent text resolution: GBIF county text Anchorage uniquely resolves to active FIPS 02020, Anchorage Municipality, Alaska.
geography.coordinatePolicy: Coordinate-derived county routing is forbidden for this run. Only explicit registered GBIF county text was considered; coordinates were neither used nor permitted to derive county identity.

taxonomy.method: Registered strict GBIF EXACT species match with confidence at least 95 and exact canonical binomial agreement; Melilotus officinalis matched GBIF speciesKey 8193111 at confidence 98.

requests.purpose: Resolve the exact registered target binomial to a stable GBIF species key before occurrence acquisition. Attempt 1 failed before an HTTP response; attempt 2 completed successfully.
Acquire the complete registered Alaska PRESERVED_SPECIMEN and PRESENT occurrence result set for exact speciesKey 8193111, then screen only explicit county-equivalent text for the leased pair.

limitations: GBIF record silence, missing county text, rejected candidates, and empty or failed requests never support verified absence or not-detected claims.

caveats: GBIF is an aggregator and publisher record quality can vary.
The accepted record is historical point-scale preserved-specimen evidence and does not imply countywide abundance or current distribution.
The live search has no fixed snapshot identifier; retained provider bytes, request URLs, timestamps, and hashes pin this screen.
Thirty-seven provider candidates lacked explicit county text and were rejected without coordinate-derived county assignment.
